name: kb.index
title: List the knowledge base
description: Lists the know-how pages you may read, each with its key, type, title and one-line summary, so you can choose which to read with kb.read. Know-how is how Fyniq works, what its statuses and screens mean, statutory guides, and the organisation's own policies and decisions. It holds no figures: figures come only from the other tools. Without a section it lists the whole index when that is short, and otherwise the sections (the first part of each page's key) with their page counts; give a section to list its pages. A page marked draft comes from a guide page still awaiting review.

section.description: Only the pages of this section: the first part of their keys, such as claims or founders.
